retraction.reason: Retracted in M44b, class A. The nearest Portuguese ground is Guinea-Bissau, a neighbour of the outbreak’s three countries and a member of the community of Portuguese-speaking states, and the atlas holds no record of Guinea-Bissau after 1973 and no record of the epidemic reaching it. An edge from the founding of the CPLP in 1996 to an epidemic in 2013 would argue nothing at all, which is the shape of edge this round exists to refuse.
